notes.note: Reviewed the historical blocker classification and host-owned custody boundary against native analytics requester additions. Requester cookie/nonce stay in host memory under profile/origin/request fencing; no renderer bearer map or keyring-to-renderer fallback is added. Existing mobile storage/DNS/backup owners are unchanged. Historical blocker evidence is retained and no physical secure-storage, restart, DNS or backup behavior is renewed.

Reviewed separate connection-broker routing/credential boundaries against native requester-consent and analytics composition changes. Telemetry companion ingestion is a different service; its operator credentials and private source grants do not enter the connection broker or replace approved Device/account credentials. Native generic relay excludes consent routes, with requester decisions on the host-held path. Existing dated local/remote broker evidence and production/native limits remain separate.

Reviewed proposal status, STATION_ROOT versus runtime STATION_HOME boundary and unauthenticated-description rule against analytics recovery changes. Fresh analytics activation is published by normal/update home restore; it neither recovers config/profiles.json nor proves source origin, credentials, root ownership or authority to start a service. Lib.rs requester additions do not implement or widen this proposed connection-list recovery journey.

Reviewed current registry ownership/lock contract and dated race-evidence limits against lib.rs additions. Native analytics requester custody adds no instances.json reader/writer, sidecar/service owner, lifecycle claim or automatic attachment. Optional companion lifecycle uses its own admitted artifact/installation/action records and does not substitute those for the Station registry. Existing registry race/platform receipts are retained, not rerun or requalified.

Reviewed historical notification failures and current push registration/delivery source boundaries against lib.rs requester-consent additions. The new in-memory pending requester session and OS review path do not change notification payloads, registration, provider opt-in or push capability reporting. No gateway/account/physical-device delivery observation was performed; dated deployment and provider receipts remain historical.

Reviewed the current status/addenda distinguishing operator sessions, explicit access:devices promotion and native consent from dated proposal assumptions. Telemetry management adds separate operator-promoted telemetry:manage without enabling sending or personal access. Personal analytics approval uses its exact requester session and cannot borrow operator/native-host/passkey authority. Existing passkey step-up and device administration remain separate; no historical line citation or device/runtime qualification is refreshed.

Reviewed retained native SSH launcher versus current server-owned Add computer composition and separate launch/pairing trust. Lib.rs analytics requester additions do not change SSH credentials, checkout verification, port-forward ownership, saved environment profiles or authenticated peer identity. No remote host command, runtime launch or SSH qualification was performed. Historical acceptance and saved-forward provenance limits remain explicit.

Reviewed the explicit historical August seam-map status against current OrchestrationService delta: usage export/invalidation delegates are added and the unused private restart forwarding wrapper is removed in favor of the existing recovery owner. Dated counts, line numbers, cast-site inventories and extraction recommendations are intentionally not rewritten. The current module map carries source routing; this review does not recertify historical event ordering or all current collaborators.
